_comment: Illustrative power ratings, not calibrated. `cafeteria_kitchen` reflects the real cafeteria this repo's source paper (Bae et al., see schedule.json's _comment) maps its own `Cafe_OCC_SCH` schedule onto (borrowed, in that paper, from the secondary-school prototype's cafeteria) -- weighted around lunch (11-13h) with a lighter evening slot (17-19h) for the evening-class population school's own kitchen item doesn't need. `classroom_lab_studio_equipment` scales up `school`'s `classroom_equipment` item to cover the broader classroom/laboratory/studio/lecture-hall AV and lab-instrumentation mix this building type spans. `faculty_office_it_equipment` mirrors `office`/`clinic`/`warehouse`'s own admin plug-load item, scaled for this type's `capacity_default`.
